name: Akagiri Michiru
source:
Born: Heisei 11 (1999)
Star Sign: Taurus

A 'librarian' sent from the British Library to Gunjou Island. He is a mixed-race born from a Japanese father and English mother. As he has lived overseas for most of his life, he struggles to use keigo when speaking Japanese. Due to his rough behavior, others often try to pick fights with him — a trouble-maker, he often returns the favor with no hesitation.

As he does not possess an official certification to become a librarian, many suspect that he was only able to become one through connections.

[From [url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2017/07/04/the-library-of-dorico-introduction/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/url]]
